title: FlashVector: Agent for Hierarchical Model Serving Stack Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.17391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model serving is one of the largest cost drivers in production recommender systems. Maximizing its throughput requires navigating a deeply layered hierarchy: GPU kernels, the ML framework computation graph, the model server, and on-demand feature processing -- each demanding specialized domain expertise. Such cross-layer expertise is inherently difficult to acquire, and does not scale with a workload that continuously grows and evolves, leaving significant cost efficiency gains unrealized. While recent AI agents have demonstrated human expert level efficiency in standalone GPU kernel optimization, automated tuning and optimization for the rest of the serving stack remain largely unexplored. We present FlashVector, an agentic system that optimizes performance across all layers of the model serving stack. translated_title: FlashVector：用于分层模型服务栈优化的智能体
translated_abstract: 模型服务是生产级推荐系统中最大的成本驱动因素之一。要最大化其吞吐量，需要驾驭一个深层次分层体系：GPU内核、机器学习框架计算图、模型服务器以及按需特征处理——每一层都需要专门领域的专业知识。这种跨层专业知识本质上难以获取，且无法随着持续增长和演变的工作负载而扩展，导致巨大的成本效率提升空间未能实现。尽管近期的AI智能体已在独立的GPU内核优化中展现出人类专家级的效率，但针对服务栈其余部分的自动化调优与优化在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们提出了FlashVector，一个能够优化模型服务栈所有层级性能的智能体系统。其关键贡献是一个可扩展的框架，能够将单一内核优化智能体范式推广到异构的技术栈……
tldr: FlashVector是一个智能体系统，通过可扩展的框架将单一GPU内核优化的智能体范式推广到模型服务栈的各个层级（包括GPU内核、ML框架计算图、模型服务器和按需特征处理），实现跨层性能优化，为推荐系统释放显著的效率与成本收益。
en_tdlr: FlashVector is an agentic system that generalizes the single-kernel optimization agent paradigm across all layers of the model serving stack—GPU kernels, ML framework computation graphs, model servers, and on-demand feature processing—through an extensible framework, unlocking significant cost efficiency gains for production recommender systems.
